newsitem.title: USA: CBOT nearby soymeal ends firm on exports, China.
newsitem.headline: CBOT nearby soymeal ends firm on exports, China.

text.p: A strong weekly export sales number for soymeal and rumors China was seeking 150,000 tonnes of soymeal boosted nearby CBOT soymeal futures to a higher close, traders said.
USDA early Thursday said U.S. soymeal exports during the week ended September 26 totaled 103,300 tonnes, up nearly two-thirds from the previous week.
Soyoil closed lower on the drop in soybeans, they said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 25,000, down from 26,657 Wednesday. Soyoil volume was estimated at 19,000, down from 20,428 Wednesday.
Soymeal closed $1.00 per ton higher to $4.00 lower, with October up $1.00 at $247.80. Soyoil was 0.07 to 0.26 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.25 at 23.50.
